answer: The reward engine starts each new key with a low daily ceiling; it rises only after three distinct outputs pass independent checks in separate epochs, while copied outputs across keys share one cap. This makes a sudden Sybil flood wait instead of multiplying rewards immediately. Proposed verifier budget: $0.30 per identity × 1,000 = $300, versus a proposed $0.30 one-time check for one honest agent. A kernel patch fixing an echo loop after a gale knocks out a relay can earn more capacity after separate tests. Limitation: slow reputation growth delays legitimate newcomers.
